title: Harden and connect public conversion intake for production
story: The public workflow-intake form, Cloudflare Pages Function, local M4 adapter, and conversion dashboard are implemented and locally validated. Complete the internal production-readiness plumbing without deploying: add abuse protection and bounded rate limiting, build an authenticated idempotent Cloudflare KV-to-M4 reconciliation job, wire it into E.G.G. and watchdog health, and produce a deployment/checklist command path that cannot lose or duplicate qualified submissions.
deliverables: Bounded abuse protection and rate limiting for form events and submissions.
An authenticated, checkpointed, idempotent KV-to-M4 import path that does not expose credentials or submission contents in logs.
E.G.G. task routing and watchdog findings for stale imports, failed imports, and qualified records not handed to the opportunity ledger.
Focused tests for duplicate races, retries, pagination, malformed KV records, internal/test records, secret redaction, and no-send behavior.
A precise activation checklist for the existing Cloudflare Pages project, KV binding, environment values, local launch agent, validation, rollback, and monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: Do not deploy, create the KV namespace, change Cloudflare bindings, publish the site, spend money, or contact anyone.
Use existing Cloudflare credentials only through environment variables or existing secret files; never print or commit tokens.
A repeated import of the same KV record creates exactly one local submission, inbox handoff, account/contact/opportunity, and commercial record.
A failed import remains retryable and does not advance its checkpoint.
A production-like local fixture reaches the canonical opportunity ledger and control-panel metrics once.
The watchdog distinguishes form endpoint health, KV import freshness, and conversion handoff lag.
Run syntax checks, focused tests, HTTP validation, and dashboard endpoint validation before returning through architect-inbox.

roi_case.revenue_goal_link: Prevents first-party website leads from being invisible or lost on the path to the March 2027 $10k cash-flow goal.
roi_case.expected_business_value: Makes inbound conversion operationally reliable instead of merely present in the website source.
roi_case.why_codex_is_worth_it: This crosses Cloudflare edge behavior, secure synchronization, local CRM idempotency, scheduled agents, monitoring, and rollback.
roi_case.success_metric: One production-like fixture is captured, imported, qualified, visible in the opportunity ledger and dashboard exactly once, with stale or failed imports surfaced automatically.
roi_case.fallback_if_not_run: Keep the public form undeployed and retain email as the only live website contact path.

safety_boundary: Repository-scoped internal implementation and local validation only. No production publish, Cloudflare account or binding changes, outreach delivery, packet approval, spending, account creation, sensitive-data export, financial activity, or external commitments.

completion.result: Cloudflare intake records are imported through authenticated Wrangler OAuth, checkpointed by hashed KV key after successful reconciliation, surfaced in E.G.G./watchdog/control-panel state, and retried after failure.
validation: Production same-origin event returned 200 and was idempotent.
Five consecutive placeholder submissions returned the expected 400 validation response after edge propagation.
Preview event reached the M4 importer in four seconds and an immediate retry processed zero records.
Watchdog reported overall_ok=true with no findings.
Control-panel public conversion API reported kv_sync.ok=true and zero unreconciled records.
completion.authorization_note: The original epic prohibited production changes. The user subsequently authorized continuation of the production activation path before namespace creation, binding, preview, and deployment.
